name: Barberton Makhonjwa Mountains
description: The Barberton Makhonjwa Mountains are a range of low hills and small peaks in Mpumalanga, north-eastern South Africa, near the border with Eswatini. Their rocks are among the oldest and best preserved on Earth, formed between 3.6 and 3.25 billion years ago. Layers of ancient lava and sediment here record meteorite impacts, volcanic eruptions, the birth of continents and traces of early life.
